name: Hri Kumar Nair
profileSummary: Hri Kumar Nair is a Singaporean lawyer and former politician who has been serving as a Judge of the High Court of Singapore since 2023. A former member of the People's Action Party, he was a Member of Parliament (MP) for the Bishan–Toa Payoh Group Representation Constituency (GRC) between 2006 and 2015. He was also a former Deputy Attorney-General of Singapore between 2017 and 2023.
